note: Corps of Engineers campground on two wooded points of Stockton Lake. 29 of the 67 RV sites have electric, all in the B loop: 50 amp at B25-B34, 30 amp at the rest. The A sites are basic, and many of them sit on the open shore of the north point. Water is a shared fill-up, not at the site, and is off outside Apr 16 to Sep 30. Reservations run Mar 15 to Nov 30. Boat ramp and beach just outside the entrance. --Claude
summary: Confirmed against rec.gov: open year-round, 67 RV sites (29 electric: ten 50A, nineteen 30A; 38 non-electric) + 13 walk-to tent sites; $20-32 Apr 16-Sep 30, $10-20 in the shoulders. Stored hookups.water TRUE corrected to false (community fill-up only). Count 91 -> 80 (catalog). Waterfront lead UP lakeview -> lakefront (counted). Pin is ~750 m west of the sites - move flagged. Phone flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP (stored lakeview, stored evidence is only a commit reference): on the leaf-off frames (lake drawn down, so distances to today's water are an upper bound) the A-point non-electric RV sites A02-A10 have pad ends 10-20 m from the water across mown grass with a few scattered trees, nothing between; A12, A14, A16, A17 on the east side of the same point are 20-30 m from the riprap shore, open; the electric row B06-B13 faces the north cove 25-35 m away across open mown grass with five or six scattered trees; B37 about 20 m. At least 13 RV sites on an open apron within 50 m (9 basic A sites + B06-B08, B10 and more), plus walk-to tent sites T01-T06 and T14-T20 on the shore. Supports LAKEFRONT. rec.gov tags only the walk-to sites 'Lakefront' (the RV sites carry no proximity attribute). No site photos were read.

PIN MOVE: stored 37.5222,-93.8053 is rec.gov's facility point, in woods about 750 m west of the nearest campsite. The sites are on two points: A loop around 37.5254,-93.7958 and the electric B loop around 37.5230,-93.7965 (catalog coordinates agree with the pads on imagery, except A29-A35 which the catalog plots in the lake). Proposed new pin 37.5230,-93.7965 (B loop).

HOOKUPS: stored water=true (derived) is wrong - every site that states it says water hookup 'No' and the notice calls it a community fill-up. Written false. Electric 50 stands but only ten sites (B25-B34) are 50 amp; the other nineteen electric sites are 30 amp; 38 RV sites have none.

SITES: rec.gov prose says 91 campsites; the catalog lists 80 individual sites (67 RV + 13 walk-to tent) plus one group camp (B22), the Mutton Creek Group Camp (a separate place 2.3 km east, 37.52524,-93.77030, filed under this facility) and a day shelter. Three A sites (A01, A09, A34) show 'Not Available'. Written 80.

WINTER: notice says open year-round; shoulder seasons Mar 15-Apr 15 and Oct 1-Nov 30 have 'No Water & No Waterborne Facilities' (vault toilets only). Dec 1-Mar 14 is outside every rate season and the calendar returns no bookable dates; what is charged then and whether the electric is on was not found on rec.gov - a question for the park (417-637-5303). The USACE lake page was not read.
PHONE (none stored; apply.py does not write it): rec.gov facility phone 417-637-5303 (park), project office 417-276-3113.
